The primary enrichment strategy is a novel nanoparticle-based protein corona approach (Proteograph), which is not explicitly listed in the provided modifier ontology but functions as a general proteome sampling/enrichment method. scope: To form the protein corona, 100 µL of NP suspension (SP-003, 5 mg/ml; SP-007, 2.5 mg/ml; SP-011, 10 mg/ml) was mixed with 100 µL of diluted biological samples in microtiter plates.
After incubation, the plate was placed on top of a magnetic collection device for 5 min to draw down the NPs. Unbound proteins in supernatant were pipetted out.
The protein corona was further washed with 200 µL of dilution buffer three times with magnetic separation.
To digest the proteins bound onto NPs, a trypsin digestion kit (iST 96×, PreOmics, Germany) was used according to protocols provided.
